dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: All you need to do to play music is activate the Autoharmonic Reed Pipes on both sides and calibrate them to match the nearby notes. That way, we can retrieve the musical score.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Autoharmonic Reed Pipes...

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Ah... Well, as their name implies, they are machines that can play music by themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Our ancient civilization was founded upon music, and many such devices have survived to this day.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: However, unlike the music box in your hands or the devices used to play the "symphony," this sort can only play a few simple chords. As such, their strength is correspondingly weaker.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: We should encounter more such instruments later, but they will not prove much of an obstacle for those who can already wield the power of the "symphony" power as we do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Pet him.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No worries.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Alright. If there is anything you wish to know, do not hesitate to ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Meow, meow! I was right to trust you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell us about your relationship to this castle...

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: You've guessed it already, I reckon. In the past, when I could still change my form freely, he... and I, and many of our companions dwelled here.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: In those days, a new nation had just been born, and as far as we were concerned, the possibilities were yet endless.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Here, we organized the classics, researching music theory and magic, in the hopes that we might tame this perilous power and use it to open up a brighter age.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: But... These possibilities would quickly become lost to us, and I alone remained...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Osse...

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: It's fine. These things happened a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Pet him.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Alright. If there is anything you wish to know, do not hesitate to ask me.
